incidents.name: BurnsBuild burnToHolder / receiveRewards
incidents.notes: BurnsBuild.burnToHolder() credits the caller with rewards proportional to a burn it does not otherwise account for, so a flash-loan-funded burn/receiveRewards cycle drained the reward pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x4fb9657Ac5d311dD54B37A75cFB873b127Eb21FD created 2024-02-04T18:46:42Z by 0xf59fc943f22e976bc74b29fffe1fc711dfab5600, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc9fbcf3eb24385491f73bbf691b13a6f8be7c339; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
